verdict.rationale: SavvyCal is a scheduling SaaS that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. Its developer docs list a REST API, webhooks, a JavaScript embed library, an MCP connection, Zapier and a Chrome extension, but nothing describes an official command-line tool. Those other integration surfaces are adjacent features and earn no credit toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
